_about: Fixture query set (A4) — the golden-set / IR-harness seed for the B3 query interface. Each entry is one query against the 14 versioned fixture nodes (nodes/ + flags/) folded into a disposable instance. 'expect_ids' is the SET of node ids the verb surfaces (open_scope/find candidates, fetch/traverse nodes); order is asserted by the unit tests, recall+precision by this set. Optional keys: 'expect_not_found' (fetch), 'expect_auto_broadened' (find), 'expect_view' (open_scope facet entry view). All queries run as archetype 'execute' under default policy. Run by warehouse_robot/tests/test_query_fixtures.py.
